name: sf-3d-app
description: Data-accurate Three.js model of San Francisco at golden hour

scripts.build: npm run lint && npm run lint:api && npm test && vite build && node scripts/compress-tiles.mjs
scripts.test: node --test test/muni-motion.test.mjs test/ferry-motion.test.mjs test/ferry-palette.test.mjs test/ferry-schedule.test.mjs test/asset-loading.test.mjs test/moods.test.mjs test/addresses.test.mjs test/places.test.mjs
